prompt: A checkpoint across an apartment street by day: a striped road barrier painted deep red (#9E1A14) with dark ink bands, manned by figures in dark blue-grey riot gear with full helmets and visors down so no faces show. A queue of ordinary civilians waits at the barrier with heads bowed and bags in hand. Flat grey overcast light, seen from street level beside the queue. Semi-realistic painted graphic-novel comic art with heavy dark ink linework, diagonal hatching in the shadows and crosshatching in the deepest shadows, realistic painted shading and muted desaturated colour. An ordinary present-day American city. Every sign, screen and surface is blank and plain.
